'''Icamsam''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Icamsam was a prominant member of [[Vermilic]], a [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clan]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carnovia]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
